body:
Update on removing `tags = ["manual"]` from the Rust test targets:

Enabled (manual tag removed)
- `//score/mw/com/impl/rust/com-api/com-api-runtime-lola:com-api-runtime-lola-tests`
- `//score/mw/com/rust/score_com_concept:score_com_concept-test`

Both pass in the default build and under `--config=asan_ubsan_lsan` and `--config=tsan_ubsan`. The sanitizer issue that was the reason for the tag no longer reproduces.

Enabled, but skipped under sanitizers
- `//score/mw/com/example/com-api-example:com-api-example-tokio-integration-test`

The tag is removed, so it runs in normal `bazel test` runs, but I excluded it from sanitizer builds. The tests pass functionally, but the Tokio multi-thread runtime (`#[tokio::test(flavor = "multi_thread")]`) triggers sanitizer findings:
- `asan_ubsan_lsan`: LeakSanitizer reports , all from `tokio::runtime::scheduler::multi_thread::MultiThread::new` / worker thread startup.
- `tsan_ubsan`: data race in `<String as Clone>::clone` between the test thread and a `tokio-rt-worker` thread. Neither stack frame is in COM code.

The target uses `target_compatible_with = select({"@score_cpp_policies//sanitizers/flags:any_sanitizer": ["@platforms//:incompatible"], "//conditions:default": []})`. It is built and run normally and reported as SKIPPED under any sanitizer config. The reason is documented in the BUILD file.

Still `manual`
- `//score/mw/com/rust/score_com_concept:score_com_concept-macros-tests` (doc test). `rust_doc_test` does not forward native C++ link flags, which fails with LLD. This is unrelated to the sanitizers.

**Follow-up**
The Tokio sanitizer findings (leak and race) need to investigate, either to fix the test/runtime setup or to add targeted suppressions. Once that is done, the `target_compatible_with` restriction can be removed.
